podcast.body: This 1987 record by The Dead Milkmen features the song "Instant Club Hit (You'll Dance to Anything)," which critiques "poser kids" who embraced techno pop. "The proper name of that song is Instant Club Hit, You Old Dance to Anything, from the 1987 Dead Milkman Record, Bucky Fellini."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
